The '''Communication Circle''', also known as the '''Communications Circle''' and '''Comm Circle''', was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kegan/Legends|Kegan]]. The various circles on Kegan formed an interconnected ring around the [[Gathering Circle]]. The Communication Circle was connected to the [[Tech Circle]] on one side and the [[Study Circle]] on the other. A [[central instruction processor]] (CIP) was guarded within the Communication Circle, used to control the [[autohopper]]s that monitored all [[Keganite]] activity. With limited technological advances on Kegan during its isolationist period, high-quality communications devices could be limited to workers assigned to the Communication Circle. [[V-Nen]] worked in the Communication Circle<ref name="TFFT" />
